summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of $1.5 billion in notes offered by its wholly owned subsidiary B.A.T Capital Corporation, split into $750 million 5.300% notes due 2033 and $750 million 5.550% notes due 2036. The notes are senior unsecured and guaranteed by BAT and affiliates. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes including potential debt repayment. Closing is expected August 5, 2026. This is an ordinary debt issuance under an existing shelf registration and does not constitute a special situation.
